description: Progressive personal income tax (PIT) brackets applied to taxable income after all allowances and deductions.
known_issue: Thai Revenue Department's own English-language page (rd.go.th/english/6045.html) is STALE — it still shows pre-2017 figures (top bracket at 4,000,000 THB, 30% max rate) and directly contradicts the current law. Do NOT cite this page as a current source for brackets, allowances, or the standard deduction rate. Verified via research pass on 2026-09-07.

rules.conditions: Applies to the first 150,000 THB of taxable income (after allowances/deductions). Effective from the 2017 tax year onward.

source.label: Sherrings — Thailand Personal Income Tax Rates (secondary source, cites Revenue Code Amendment Act (No. 44) B.E. 2560, gazetted 27 Jan 2017)

rules.verification_notes: Confirmed via a reputable secondary source with a named legal basis (Amendment Act No. 44), but not yet a primary RD/Revenue Code citation — RD's own English page for this is stale (see known_issue above) and no working primary-law page was located during this research pass.

rules.conditions: Applies to taxable income from 150,001 to 300,000 THB. Effective from the 2017 tax year onward.

source.label: Sherrings — Thailand Personal Income Tax Rates

rules.conditions: Applies to taxable income from 300,001 to 500,000 THB. Effective from the 2017 tax year onward.
